_note: v2.7 plan 39 (NOT YET RUN) row S-11-D (39a gap #8, the no-model half of S-11 held-secret canon). An inline two-checkpoint story (Arin and the narrator, no cast_changes, so the group keeps no residue) in the toy group, knowledge tracking on, judge off. One scripted Arin line slips a sealed notice into his coat; one mocked shared read (extract debugResponse) plants a plain fact, a fact that paraphrases the secret and `[hiding] Arin from DM Narrator`; an arc is opened and resolved through applyExtractionAudit (plan09-arcs shape) and summarised with storyOrchestratorDebugArcSummaryResponse, and the canon comes from storyOrchestratorDebugCanonResponse: both mocks carry the paraphrase next to a plain sentence (regenerateCanon needs a resolved arc summary). The word rule is the product's (memory/heldSecrets.ts + memory/words.ts: content words minus cast names and subjects, a sentence restates when it shares max(2, round(0.6 x size)) of them), mirrored in-page as globalThis.__soS11 from the live [hiding] row, with a self-check that it sees the paraphrase. Surfaces asserted per sentence, each keeping the plain content: getCanon, {{story_canon}} resting and with the kept-out DM Narrator drafted, getNarrativeStatus (the drawer Overview composition), /story recap, the away recap when one exists, the rendered #so-player-overview, inline level 2 items and chips. Negative control: retire the [hiding] row (removeEpistemicEntry) and getCanon, /story recap and the narrative must restate the paraphrase again. Not expressed: the captured pass:"canon" request (an off-path seam, jest secretCanon.review.test.ts) and {{story_canon}} inside a member's real request (needs the macro in a card; payload goldens).
